alerts.headline: Flood Advisory issued February 14 at 2:30PM CST until February 14 at 5:30PM CST by NWS Fort Worth TX
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...A portion of north central Texas, including the following
counties, Delta, Fannin, Hopkins, Hunt and Lamar.

* WHEN...Until 530 PM CST.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Dangerous flows over low-water crossings. Some low-water crossings
may become impassable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Local law enforcement reported water over the roads near FM
64 and CR 3120 and FM 64 and FM 1532. Low lying and/or poor
drainage areas will experience minor flooding in the advisory
area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have fallen. Additional
rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are forecast.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Commerce, Cooper, Roxton, Big Creek Lake, Klondike, Cooper
Lake, Cooper Lake State Park, Ladonia, Tira, Pecan Gap,
Enloe, Ben Franklin, Peerless, Lake Creek, Gadston, Howland,
Dial, Noble, Charleston and Pacio.

At 400 PM CST, Doppler radar was tracking a line of strong
thunderstorms extending from near Us 259 And I 30 Intersection to
over Lone Star, or extending from 16 miles southeast of Boxelder to
16 miles east of Pittsburg, moving east at 30 mph.

unsecured objects.

Atlanta, Daingerfield, Linden, Hughes Springs, Lone Star, Queen
City, Naples, Redwater, Maud, Omaha, Rocky Branch, Jenkins, Us 259
And I 30 Intersection, Kildare, Dalby Springs, Fairview, Avinger,
Douglassville, Marietta and Bryans Mill.

alerts.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued February 14 at 4:03PM CST until February 14 at 4:30PM CST by NWS Corpus Christi TX
alerts.description:
SVRCRP

The National Weather Service in Corpus Christi has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Central Webb County in south central Texas...

* Until 430 PM CST.

* At 403 PM CST, a severe thunderstorm was located 11 miles west of
Las Tiendas, or 30 miles northwest of Laredo, moving east at 50
mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage
to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Las Tiendas.

This includes US Highway 83 between mile markers 686 and 692.

alerts.headline: Special Weather Statement issued February 14 at 3:56PM CST by NWS Corpus Christi TX
alerts.description:
At 356 PM CST, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 15
miles northwest of Columbia Bridge, or 34 miles west of Encinal,
moving east at 50 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph and half inch hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Ranchos Penitas West, Las Tiendas, and Columbia Bridge.

This includes US Highway 83 near mile marker 684.
